buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses OUR REF NO. NER/RPC/9001-0737 Name of package: Hiring of Comprehensive Pest Control Services at POWERGRID Silcha r (Srikona) Substation A. Scope of Work: ‘Hiring of Comprehensive Pest Control Services at POWERGRID Silchar (Srikona) Substation’ as per details, terms and conditions indicated in the bidding documents, i n perfect condition, along with driver, all consumables, tools & tackles, spares and uniform of driv er at the cost of the contractor. The detailed scope work shall be as per ‘Bid Specific Additional Te rms and Conditions (ATC)’ and as per instruction of Engineer/Officer-In-Charge and other relevant Clauses of the tender documents. B. The bidder must be a ‘Class-I local supplier’ as defined under Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order as per bidding documents. Firms who are not ‘Class-I local supplier shall not b e eligible to bid. Presently, the local content requirement to categorize a supplier as ‘Cla ss-I local supplier’ is minimum 60%. The ‘Class-I local supplier’ shall give a self-certific ation in his bid in the given format, indicating the percentage of Local Content and certifying that the item offered meets the Local Content requirement for ‘Class –I local supplier’ and shall giv e details of the location(s) at which value addition is made. C. It is the Employer’s (POWERGRID’s) policy that requires the bidder to sign a declaratio n along with its bid about abiding by a ‘Code of Integrity for Public Procurement’. All bi dders are required to submit the same as a part of their technical bid. This policy is detai led in the bidding documents. D. Bid Specific Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC), Bid Forms and Qualification Requir ements against this tender package is enclosed as “Buyer uploaded ATC document” to this bid document. Bidder shall ensure to submit an acceptable Bid Security/EMD, mandatorily submit all d ocuments in support of Qualification Requirements and all the Bid Forms duly filled, sig ned, completed and submit the same as a part of their technical bid.

E. Site information: It is imperative for bidder to satisfy himself completely of all local co nditions. In addition, the Bidder are expected to assess any problems relating to the m eans of access to the site, the accommodation they may require and its availability, be sides any other aspects including financial implication affecting the execution of the co ntract covered under these documents and specifications. A Bidder shall be deemed to have full knowledge of the site (whether he inspects or not) and no claim whatsoever o n this account at any stage shall be entertained. Submission of Bid by a Bidder implies that he has read this notice and all other Tender Documents and has made himself awa re of the scope and specifications of the work to be done and of conditions as well as o f local conditions and other factors which may have bearing on the execution of the wo rks. F. CPG/Security Deposit (SD): As a security towards satisfactory performance of the Cont ract, the successful Bidder, to whom the work is awarded, shall be required to furnish a Performance Guarantee in favour of the Owner within 28 days from the date of Contr act order. As an alternate option to CPG, pro-rata deduction as @5% from the bills of the contract or, up-to 5% of the total contract value, shall be made towards Security Deposit in lieu of PBG; for which contractor shall confirm either of the options. In case of any amendment to the contract, the Contract price, as amended, shall be th e reference price for determining the value of Performance Guarantee/Security Deposit . The contractor shall accordingly, increase/decrease the Bank Guarantee/Security Dep osit value submitted towards Contract Performance Guarantee based on the amended c ontract value. Security Deposit shall be returned to the Contractor on successful compl etion of the works under the Contract after 90-Ninety days of end of the contract validi ty period. No interest shall be pay able to the Contractor against Security Deposit. G. Issuing Banks: The Bank Guarantee for Performance Security are to be provided by the Service Provider which should be issued either by a Public Sector Bank located in India, or a scheduled Indian Bank having pa id up capital (net of any accumulated losses) of R s. 1,000 million or above (the latest annual report of the Bank should support complian ce of capital adequacy ratio requirement) as per List of Banks enclosed. H. "While executing the contract, the contractor shall stand comply with all requirements of Social Accountability Standards i.e. SA8000 (latest Standard available at www.sa-int l.org) and maintain the necessary records." I. POWERGRID Whistle Blower and Fraud Prevention Policy: The Contractor along with its associate/ collaborators/ sub-contractors/ sub-vendors/consultants/ service providers s hall strictly adhere to the Whistle Blower and Fraud Prevention Policy of Employer disp layed on its tender website https://apps.powergrid.in/pgciltenders/u/default.aspx and h ttps://www.powergrid.in/index.php/en/code-conductpolicies The Contractor along with their associate / collaborator / subcontractors / sub-vendors / consultants / service providers shall observe the highest standard of ethics and shall n ot indulge or allow anybody else working in their organization to indulge in fraudulent activities during execution of the contract. The contractor shall immediately apprise th

e Employer about any fraud or suspected fraud as soon as it comes to their no tice. J. Bidder shall comply with all terms and conditions as detailed in the bidding documents. Bids not c onforming to this requirement are liable to be rejected. K. Bidders may note that the Owner (POWERGRID) has uploaded its ‘Works & Procurement Policy an d Procedure’: Vol-I &Vol-II to POWERGRID’s website. Those bidders who wish to peruse the same may visit www.powergrid.in. However, it shall be noted that no other party, including the Bidder/ C ontractor, shall derive any right from this ‘Works & Procurement Policy and Procedure’ documents or have any claim on the Owner on the basis of the same. The respective rights of Owner and Bidd ers/ Contractors shall be governed by the bidding documents/ contracts signed between the Owne r and the Contractor for the package. The provisions of bidding documents shall always prevail ov er that of ‘Works & Procurement Policy and Procedure’ documents. L. If a bid is not substantially responsive, it will be rejected by POWERGRID, and may not subsequent ly be made responsive by the Bidder by correction of the nonconformity. POWERGRID’s determinat ion of a bid’s responsiveness is to be based on the contents of the bid itself without recourse to ex trinsic evidence. . 2.
